## Data safety

Remove credentials, callback URLs, personal media/transcripts and private backups from this report. Read [support guidance](https://github.com/WilsonLe/LocalCut/blob/main/SUPPORT.md). Suspected vulnerabilities belong in the [security reporting process](https://github.com/WilsonLe/LocalCut/blob/main/SECURITY.md), not a public reproduction.
